name: Ginger

low.description: About 1 teaspoon grated - standard culinary amount

siboNotes: Ginger is excellent for SIBO patients - not only is it low FODMAP, but it acts as a NATURAL PROKINETIC that supports gut motility. Studies show it increases gastric emptying. Consider using regularly to support the migrating motor complex.
preparationTips: Fresh ginger can be grated, sliced, or minced
Makes excellent tea for digestive support
Ground ginger is also low FODMAP
Freeze fresh ginger for easy grating
